gui.name: Graphical User Interface
gui.description: GUI stands for Graphical User Interface. It allows people to interact with computers using visual elements such as windows, icons, buttons, menus, and images instead of only typing commands.

linux.name: Linux
linux.description: Linux is an open-source operating system kernel created by Linus Torvalds in 1991. Many operating systems are built using Linux.

python.name: Python Programming Language
python.description: Python is a high-level programming language known for its simple syntax and wide use in software development, automation, artificial intelligence, and data science.

ai.name: Artificial Intelligence
ai.description: Artificial Intelligence is the field of creating computer systems that can perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognizing images, and solving problems.

computer.name: Computer
computer.description: A computer is an electronic machine that processes data, performs calculations, stores information, and runs applications.
